verdict.rationale: The 01 is an open-source voice-interface platform whose assistants can execute code, browse the web, and control software, so event-triggered automation is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence documents no rules engine, event triggers, or automatic actions. Profile customization of behavior and system messages is an adjacent configuration feature, not event-driven rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
